decisions.reason: The source specifies separate power-to-main interboard connectors; it does not change the battery connector's JST-PH 3-pin electrical interface.
The candidate already records the JST-PH/JST-GH interboard sourceability strategy from message 100; message 101 adds electrical pinouts without changing the sourcing policy.
Routing SDA0 and SCL0 through the signal connector does not change the established cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source defines power-to-main connector pinouts and does not alter the battery connector's placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The interboard connector carries 5V and 5V_EN signals, but the source does not change the sensor rail's voltage, converter, GPIO control, pull-down, loads, or operating pattern.
The connector electrical specification does not explicitly change the power board's size, aspect ratio, mounting holes, USB-C position, or enclosure-fit constraints.
